visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands in a studio setting. Behind him is a digital background of the Taipei skyline at night with Taipei 101 visible. He speaks directly to the camera with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. (2) A brief graphic overlay appears showing an artistic depiction of an underwater ruin with several white stone columns submerged in deep blue water. (3) A highly detailed, dark-colored graphic of a Cthulhu-like monster with many tentacles and glowing eyes is overlaid on the screen while the man continues talking. (4) Real-life video footage from a deep-sea submersible shows a small, translucent, bioluminescent creature (a juvenile colossal squid) with visible internal organs swimming against a dark, near-black ocean background. (5) A static photograph is displayed showing a large, red-bodied giant squid carcass being inspected by several individuals wearing blue protective suits and gloves in an indoor research setting. (6) The host returns to the center of the frame, pointing downward with both index fingers towards a call-to-action text box that appears at the bottom of the screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 傳說中的深海巨獸 終於現身了. [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 百年首見！「活」巨魷現身鏡頭前. (2) [Subtitle]: 它是地球上已知最重的無脊椎動物. (3) [Subtitle]: 成年體重可以超過500公斤. (4) [Subtitle]: 體長可達4公尺. (5) [Subtitle]: 差不多一層樓那麼高. (6) [Subtitle]: 觸手跟大谷翔平的手臂差不多粗. (7) [Subtitle]: 它住在深達數百到上千公尺的極端環境中. (8) [Subtitle]: 因此雖然1925年就被科學家命名. (9) [Subtitle]: 但整整100年來卻沒有人拍到它活著的樣子. (10) [Subtitle]: 這位傳說中的神秘嘉賓就是克蘇魯. (11) [Subtitle]: 是大王酸漿魷 (Mesonychoteuthis hamiltoni). (12) [Subtitle]: 今年3月施密特海洋研究所的潛水器 「SuBastian」. (13) [Subtitle]: 在南冰洋560公尺深的海域終於首次拍到它的活體幼體. (14) [Subtitle]: 記錄它的伸展運動方式. (15) [Subtitle]: 這是人類第一次看到它「活著」的模樣. (16) [Subtitle]: 別看它現在還是透明狀的. (17) [Subtitle]: 等它長大之後就會變成紅色. (18) [Subtitle]: 像這樣 看起來真好吃. (19) [Subtitle]: 加一點好事多胡椒鹽. [Variety]: ㄎㄎ. (20) [Subtitle]: 啊不是 是看起來真的好巨大. (21) [Subtitle]: 不過如果這麼大的生物都能一直躲過我們的攝影機. (22) [Subtitle]: 那究竟還有多少海產. (23) [Subtitle]: 我是說海底生物是我們沒有見過的呢. (24) [Subtitle]: 想了解更多科學新聞嗎 快點這裡. [Variety]: 快留言許願 下週《泛科NEWS》就來報!

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator begins speaking in a high-arousal, energetic, and professional tone. The background is filled with an upbeat electronic EDM track featuring a driving synthetic bass and crisp electronic drums. (2) A fast 'whoosh' digital sound effect triggers as visual overlays appear, matching the narrator's transition to scientific facts. (3) The narrator's speech rate increases slightly as he details the physical dimensions of the colossal squid, while the music maintains a consistent, high-energy rhythm. (4) A comic 'pop' sound effect occurs when the narrator makes a joke about Cthulhu, and his tone shifts to a slightly more humorous, teasing delivery. (5) The audio concludes with the narrator inviting viewers to subscribe, accompanied by a final bright synthesizer chord and the BGM fading out quickly.
